mentions.name: LookAway
mentions.description: A Mac app that reminds users to take breaks from the screen at contextually appropriate moments instead of interrupting them at random. It tracks how much time is spent in each app, with website tracking being added for a fuller usage picture. LookAway delays a due break while the user is typing so it doesn't interrupt at a bad time, and smarter break-timing detection for dictation is in development.
mentions.problem: Break reminder apps typically interrupt users at random times instead of at the right moment.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on LookAway, a Mac app that reminds you to take breaks from the screen at the right moment instead of interrupting you at random. https://lookaway.com

mentions.name: LookAway
mentions.description: A screen-time management app that acts as an antidote to seductive screens, helping users avoid eye strain, digital fatigue, computer vision syndrome (CVS), and posture issues caused by prolonged screen use. It manages screen time with the same importance the author ascribes to managing sleep.
mentions.problem: Eye strain, digital fatigue, CVS, posture issues, and other problems caused by prolonged screen use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building LookAway[1] - an antidote to seductive screens. Many people have been facing issues like eye strain, digital fatigue, CVS, posture issues, and more due to prolonged screen use and I aim to solve it with this product.
